recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of two smiling young people framed by a thick teal border and a white inner square. The composition features bold, layered typography at the top and a circular promotional sticker element on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Teal outer border containing a white square field
Script title overlapping the top edge of the white field
Sans-serif secondary text inside a rounded pill-shaped bar
Subject in red satin jacket as the primary foreground element
coreInvariants: High-key studio lighting with soft shadows
Triadic color scheme of teal, magenta-red, and white
Layered header typography with drop shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects centered, waist-up, filling the bottom two-thirds of the white square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red satin jacket in the lower right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the magenta script at the top, moves down to the faces, and settles on the red jacket and promotional circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space concentrated around the heads of the subjects to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and clothing against a neutral white background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to teal, red, white, and dark purple/blue for text bars.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slanted casual script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary script features heavy weight, high slant, and connected lowercase letters
Secondary text uses ultra-wide tracking and uniform stroke weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'K' and 'J' in script have exaggerated flourishes
Sans-serif letters are spaced to fill the horizontal width of the container bar

composition.overlap: overlaps white field and teal border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for personality paired with a wide geometric sans for structural stability.

preserve: The wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, slanted 70s pop energy
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of two smiling teenagers, one in a shiny red satin jacket, set against a plain white background. Frame the entire image with a thick teal border, leaving a white square in the center for the subjects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a slanted magenta script title at the top, overlapping the teal border. Below it, add a dark purple rounded bar containing wide-spaced yellow uppercase sans-serif text. Add a red circular sticker with white text on the middle-left.

verificationChecks: Is the teal border thick and consistent?
Does the script text have a soft drop shadow?
Is the secondary text inside a rounded bar?
Is the jacket material rendered with a satin-like sheen?

adjustableVariables: Specific wording on the promotional sticker
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or signatures
The exact text content of the promotional sticker
The catalog number in the top right corner
postGenerationChecks: Verify the script text is slanted and bold.
Ensure the teal border does not have a texture.
Check that the white inner square is perfectly centered.
Confirm the red jacket has high-specular highlights.
